paragraphs: 3:33. This verse was revealed when the Jews said: We are upon the religion of Adam, Muslims. So God sent down Indeed God chose Adam: He elected Adam for Islam; and Noah: for Islam; and the family of Abraham: the children of Abraham, for Islam; and the family of ʿImrān: Moses and Aaron, for Islam; above the worlds: the people of their age. And it is said that ʿImrān was not the father of Moses and Aaron.

3:34. Offspring, one from another: some of them upon the religion of others, and some of them born of others; and God is All-Hearing: of the saying of the Jews, "We are the sons of God and His beloved ones, upon His religion"; All-Knowing: of their punishment, and of who is upon His religion.

3:35. And remember, O Muḥammad, when the wife of ʿImrān said: Ḥannah, the mother of Mary; My Lord, I have vowed to You: I have made over to You; what is in my womb, consecrated: as a servant for the sanctuary of Jerusalem (Bayt al-Maqdis); so accept it from me; indeed You are the All-Hearing: of supplication; the All-Knowing: of the answer, and of what is in my womb.

3:36. Then when she delivered her: gave birth to her, and behold, she was a girl; she said: My Lord, I have delivered her, a female: I have given birth to her, a girl; and God knows best what she delivered: what she gave birth to; and the male is not: in service and in the matter of nakedness (ʿawra); like the female: like the girl; and I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her with You: I place her under Your protection and guard her by You; and her offspring: if she should have offspring; from Satan the accursed: the damned.

3:37. So her Lord accepted her with a gracious acceptance: that is, He dealt graciously with her, so that He accepted her in place of a boy; and made her grow in a goodly growth: He nourished her in worship, through the years and the months and the days and the hours, with a goodly nourishment; and Zachariah took charge of her: he took her to himself to raise her; whenever Zachariah entered upon her in the sanctuary: meaning her chamber in which she used to worship; he found with her provision: the fruit of winter in summer, such as sugar-cane, and the fruit of summer in winter, such as grapes; he said: O Mary, whence comes this to you?: from where do you have this, out of its season?; She said: It is from God: Gabriel brought it to me; indeed God provides for whom He wills: He gives to whom He wills, in its season and out of its season; without reckoning: without measure and without stint.

3:38. There: at that; Zachariah prayed: and hoped; to his Lord; he said: My Lord, grant me: give me; from Yourself: from Your presence; a goodly offspring: a righteous child; indeed You are the Hearer of prayer: the Answerer of prayer.

3:39. Then the angels called him: meaning Gabriel; while he stood praying in the sanctuary: in the place of worship; that God gives you glad tidings of John: of a son to be named John; confirming a Word from God: Jesus son of Mary, that he comes to be by a word from God, created without a father; and a master: forbearing in the face of ignorance; and chaste: he had no desire for women; and a prophet from among the righteous: from among the messengers.

3:40. He said: My Lord: Zachariah said to Gabriel: O my master; how shall I have a boy: from where shall I have a child; when old age has reached me: when old age has overtaken me; and my wife is barren: sterile, she does not bear; He said: Gabriel; Thus: as I have told you; God does what He wills: as He wills.

3:41. He said: Zachariah; My Lord: that is, O my Lord; appoint for me a sign: a mark of my wife's pregnancy; He said: Your sign: your mark of your wife's pregnancy; is that you shall not speak to people: you will not be able to speak to people; for three days: without being dumb; except by gesture: except by a movement of the lips, the eyebrows, the eyes and the hands; and it is said, except by writing on the ground; and remember your Lord: with the tongue and the heart; much: in every state; and glorify Him in the evening and the early morning: pray in the morning and in the evening as you used to pray.

3:42. And when the angels said: meaning Gabriel; O Mary, indeed God has chosen you: it is said, He elected you for Islam and worship; and purified you: from unbelief, polytheism and impurities; and it is said, He saved you from being killed; and chosen you: elected you; above the women of the worlds: the women of your age, by the birth of Jesus.

3:43. O Mary, be devout to your Lord: obey your Lord, in gratitude for that; and it is said, prolong the standing in prayer, in gratitude to your Lord; and prostrate and bow: its meaning is, bow and prostrate, by bowing and prostrating; with those who bow: with the people of prayer.

3:44. That: this which I have related of the account of Mary and Zachariah; is of the tidings of the unseen: of the reports of what is hidden from you, O Muḥammad; which We reveal to you: He says, We send Gabriel to you with it; and you were not with them: meaning with the rabbis; when they cast their pens: into the running water; as to which of them should take charge: should take; of Mary: to raise her; and you were not with them: in their presence; when they disputed: argued with proofs over the raising of Mary.

3:45. When the angels said: meaning Gabriel; O Mary, indeed God gives you glad tidings of a Word from Him: of a son who will come to be by a word from God, created; whose name is the Messiah: he is called the Messiah because he travels (yasīḥ) through the lands; and it is said, the Messiah means the king; Jesus son of Mary, eminent in this world: he has rank and station in this world among people; and the Hereafter: and in the Hereafter, with God, he has rank and station; and of those brought near: to God, in the Garden of Eden.

3:46. And he will speak to people in the cradle: in the lap, at forty days old: "I am the servant of God and His Messiah"; and in maturity: after thirty years, with prophethood; and of the righteous: of the messengers.

3:47. She said: My Lord: Mary said to Gabriel: O my master; how shall I have a child: from where shall I have a boy, a child; when no man has touched me: neither lawfully nor unlawfully; He said: Gabriel; Thus: as I have told you; God creates what He wills: as He wills; when He decrees a matter: when He wills to create a child from you without a father; He only says to it, Be, and it is: a child without a father.

3:48. And He will teach him the Book: the books of the prophets; and it is said, writing; and the Wisdom: the lawful and the unlawful; and it is said, the wisdom of the prophets before him; and the Torah: in his mother's womb; and the Gospel: after his coming forth from his mother's womb.

3:49. And a messenger: after thirty years; to the Children of Israel: and when he came to them he said: I have come to you with a sign: with a mark; from your Lord: of my prophethood. They said: And what is the mark? He said: I create: I fashion; for you from clay the likeness of a bird: the semblance of a bird; then I breathe into it: like the breathing of a sleeper; and it becomes a bird: it turns into a bird that flies between heaven and earth; by God's leave: by God's command. So he fashioned for them a bat, and they said: This is sorcery; have you anything else? He said: Yes. And I heal: I make sound; the blind from birth: he who has never ceased to be blind; and the leper: likewise; and I give life to the dead by God's leave: by the greatest name of God, "O Living, O Self-Subsisting". When he had done that, they said: This is sorcery; have you anything else? He said: Yes. And I inform you: I tell you; of what you eat: morning and evening; and what you store up: what you put away from the morning meal for the evening meal, and from the evening meal for the morning meal; in your houses. Indeed in that: in what I have told you; is a sign: a mark; for you: of my prophethood; if you are believers: assenting.

3:50. And confirming: and I have come to you in agreement, in the profession of God's oneness, in religion; what was before me of the Torah: what was before me of the Torah and the rest of the scriptures; and to make lawful for you: to grant you licence and make clear to you; some of that which: the making lawful of some of that which; was forbidden to you: such as the flesh of camels, the fat of cattle and sheep, the Sabbath, and other things. And I have come to you with a sign: with a mark; from your Lord; so fear God: so be in awe of God in what He has commanded you, and turn to Him in repentance; and obey me: and follow my command and my religion.

3:51. Indeed God is my Lord: He is my Lord; and your Lord, so worship Him: so declare Him One; this: the profession of His oneness; is a straight path: an upright religion with which He is pleased, and it is Islam.

3:52. Then when he perceived: knew; Jesus, from them, unbelief: and saw from them killing, when they wanted to kill him; and it is said, "he perceived" means he heard from them the repetition of unbelief; he said: Jesus; Who are my helpers: who are my supporters; towards God: with God, against His enemies; the disciples said: his chosen ones, the fullers (al-qaṣṣārūn), and they were twelve men; We are the helpers of God: your supporters, with God, against His enemies; we believe in God, and bear witness: know, you, O Jesus; that we are Muslims: acknowledging God with worship and the profession of His oneness.

3:53. Our Lord: O our Lord; we believe in what You have sent down: of the Book, meaning the Gospel; and we follow the Messenger: the religion of the Messenger, Jesus; so write us down among the witnesses: so make us among the foremost, the first ones, who bore witness before us; and it is said, so make us of the community of Muḥammad (peace and blessings be upon him).

3:54. And they schemed: they intended, meaning the Jews, the killing of Jesus; and God schemed: God intended the killing of their companion Qaṭyānūs{{fn:The name given in this commentary to the man upon whom the likeness of Jesus was cast and who was killed in his place; it is spelt variously in the manuscripts (Qaṭyānūs, Ṭaṭyānūs).}}; and God is the best of schemers: the strongest of those who intend; and it is said, the most excellent of those who contrive.

3:55. When God said: O Jesus, I am going to take you and raise you: this is an advancing and a postponing in the order of words; He says: I am going to raise you; to Myself, and purify you: deliver you; from those who disbelieve: in you; and make those who follow you: who follow your religion; above those who disbelieve: in proof and in victory; until the Day of Resurrection: then I am going to take you, seizing you in death after the descent; and it is said, taking your heart away from love of this world; then to Me is your return: after death; and I shall judge between you: I shall decide between you; in that wherein you: in religion; used to differ: used to dispute.

3:56. As for those who disbelieve: in God and His Messenger Muḥammad, and in Jesus; I shall punish them with a severe punishment in this world: by the sword and the poll-tax (jizya); and the Hereafter: by the Fire; and they shall have no helpers: none to ward off from them the punishment of God in this world and the Hereafter.

3:57. And as for those who believe: in God, the Book, and the Messenger Muḥammad, and in Jesus; and do righteous deeds: between themselves and their Lord, sincerely; He will pay them in full: He will give them in abundance; their rewards: their recompense in the Garden on the Day of Resurrection; and God does not love the wrongdoers: the polytheists, for their wrongdoing and their polytheism.

3:58. That: which I have related, O Muḥammad, of the account of Jesus; We recite to you: We send down Gabriel to you with it; of the signs: He says, of the verses of the Qur'an, with command and prohibition; and the wise Reminder: the one made firm with the lawful and the unlawful; and it is said, in agreement with the Torah and the Gospel; and it is said, the Preserved Tablet.

3:59. Then He made clear the creation of Jesus without a father, because of the words of the delegation of the Banū Najrān: "Bring us a proof from the Qur'an for your claim that Jesus is not the son of God." So God said: Indeed the likeness of Jesus: the likeness of the creation of Jesus; with God: without a father; is as the likeness of Adam; He created him from dust: without father or mother; then He said to him: to Jesus; Be, and he was: a child without a father.

3:60. The truth: it is the true report; from your Lord: that Jesus was not God, nor His son, nor His partner; so do not be of the doubters: of those who doubt what I have made clear to you of the creation of Jesus without a father.

3:61. Then He mentioned the dispute of the delegation of the Banū Najrān with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), after it had been made clear to them that his likeness with God is as the likeness of Adam; they said: It is not as you say, that Jesus was not God, nor His son, nor His partner. So God said: Then whoever argues with you concerning him: whoever disputes with you concerning him, concerning Jesus; after what has come to you of knowledge: of the clear exposition that Jesus was not God, nor His son, nor His partner; say: Come, let us call our sons: let us bring out our sons; and your sons: bring out, you, your sons; and our women: let us bring out our women; and your women: bring out, you, your women; and ourselves: let us come out ourselves; and yourselves: come out, you, yourselves; then let us pray earnestly: let us humbly implore and strive in supplication; and invoke: and lay; the curse of God: in what is between us; upon the liars: against God concerning Jesus.

3:62. Indeed this: which I have related, O Muḥammad, of the account of Jesus and of the delegation of the Banū Najrān; is the true narrative: the true report, that Jesus was not God, nor His son, nor His partner; and there is no god but God: without child and without partner; and indeed God is the Mighty: in vengeance against him who does not believe in Him; the Wise: God commanded that none other than He be worshipped; and it is said, the Judge (al-ḥakam): He decreed against them the mutual cursing (mulāʿana), but they turned away from it and did not go out to the mutual cursing with the Prophet (upon him be blessings and peace), because they knew that they were liars and that Muḥammad was a truthful prophet, sent, whose description and attributes are in their scripture.

3:63. So God said: Then if they turn away: from your call to the mutual cursing with the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him); then indeed God is All-Knowing of the corrupters: of the Christians of the Banū Najrān.

3:64. Then He called them to the profession of God's oneness and said: Say: O People of the Book, come to a word: "There is no god but God"; equitable: just; between us and you, that we worship none but God: that we declare none One but God; and associate nothing with Him: of created beings; and that none of us take others as lords: that none of us obey any of the chiefs in disobedience to God; besides God. But they refused that too, so God said: Then if they turn away: turn aside and withdraw from the profession of God's oneness; then say: Bear witness: know, you; that we are Muslims: acknowledging Him with worship and the profession of His oneness.

4:155. So for their breaking: so because of their breaking; of their covenant: We did to them what We did; and their disbelief in the signs of God: and for their disbelief in Muḥammad and the Qur'an, the poll-tax (jizya) was imposed upon them; and their killing: and for their killing; of the prophets without right: without any crime, We destroyed them; and their saying: and for their saying; Our hearts are wrapped: receptacles for every knowledge, yet they do not take in your speech and your knowledge; rather, God has set a seal upon them: rather, it is not as they said, but God has sealed their hearts; for their disbelief: in Muḥammad and the Qur'an; so they do not believe: in Muḥammad and the Qur'an; except a few: ʿAbd Allāh ibn Salām and his companions.
4:156. And for their disbelief: in Jesus and the Gospel; and their saying: and for their saying; against Mary a tremendous calumny: and that is the false accusation; We made them swine.

4:157. And their saying: and for their saying; Indeed we killed the Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, the Messenger of God: God destroyed their companion Ṭaṭyānūs{{fn:The name given in this commentary to the man upon whom the likeness of Jesus was cast and who was killed in his place; it is spelt variously in the manuscripts (Ṭaṭyānūs, Qaṭyānūs).}}; and they did not kill him, nor did they crucify him, but it was made to appear so to them: the likeness of Jesus was cast upon Ṭaṭyānūs, and they killed him in place of Jesus; and indeed those who differ concerning him: concerning his killing; are in doubt about it: about his killing; they have no: concerning his killing; knowledge of it, except the following of conjecture: and not even conjecture; and they did not kill him for certain: that is, for certain they did not kill him.
4:158. Rather, God raised him up to Himself: to heaven; and God is Mighty: in vengeance upon His enemies; Wise: in granting victory to His friends: He saved His prophet and destroyed their companion.

4:159. And there is none of: and there is not of; the People of the Book: the Jews and the Christians, anyone; but will surely believe in him: in Jesus, that he was not a sorcerer, nor God, nor His son, nor His partner; before his death: before his soul departs, after the descent of Jesus; then he dies after every Jew who is alive in their time; and on the Day of Resurrection he will be: Jesus; a witness against them: to the conveying of the message.

5:110. When God said: God has said; O Jesus son of Mary, remember My favour: keep in mind My grace; upon you: with prophethood; and upon your mother: with Islam and worship; when I strengthened you: aided you; with the Holy Spirit: with Gabriel, the purified; he instructed you and aided you in speaking to people; you speak to people in the cradle: in the lap and on the bed: "I am the servant of God and His Messiah"; and in maturity: and He aided you after thirty years: "I am the Messenger of God to you"; and when I taught you the Book: the books of the prophets; and it is said, script with the pen; and the Wisdom: the wisdom of the wise; and it is said, the lawful and the unlawful; and the Torah: and I taught you the Torah in your mother's womb; and the Gospel: after your coming forth; and when you create: fashion; from clay the likeness of a bird: the semblance of a bird, and it is the bat; by My leave: by My command; then you breathe into it: like the breathing of a sleeper; and it becomes a bird: it turns into a bird that flies between heaven and earth; by My leave: by My command and My will; and you heal: make sound; the blind from birth: he who is born blind; and the leper by My leave: by My command, My will and My power; and when you bring forth: give life to; the dead by My leave: by My will and My giving of life; and when I restrained: held back; the Children of Israel from you: when they intended to kill you; when you came to them: at the time you came to them; with clear proofs: with command and prohibition and the wonders which you showed them; and those who disbelieved among them said: among the Children of Israel; This is nothing: this which Jesus shows us is nothing; but manifest sorcery: evident. And if you read it "a manifest sorcerer" (sāḥir mubīn), they meant Jesus by it.

5:111. And when I inspired the disciples: I inspired the disciples, the fullers (al-qaṣṣārūn), and they were twelve men; to believe in Me and in My Messenger: Jesus; they said: We believe: in You and in Your Messenger Jesus; and bear witness: you, O Jesus; and they bore witness one for another; that we are Muslims: sincere in worship and in the profession of God's oneness.

5:112. When the disciples said: the chosen ones, meaning Simon the Chosen (Shamʿūn al-Ṣafī); O Jesus son of Mary: your people say to you; can your Lord: will your Lord do it; and if you read it with tāʾ and the accusative on the yāʾ{{fn:The variant reading hal tastaṭīʿu rabbaka, "can you ask your Lord", in place of hal yastaṭīʿu rabbuka, "can your Lord".}}, you say: can you ask your Lord; send down to us a table: food; from heaven? He said: Jesus, to Simon: Say to them, Fear God: be in awe of God; if you are: since you are; believers: certain in faith; for perhaps you will abandon gratitude for it and He will punish you. So Simon said that to them.

5:113. They said: We wish to eat of it and that our hearts be reassured: by what you show us of wonders; and that we may know: and be certain; that you have told us the truth: in what you say; and that we may be witnesses to it: when we return to our people.

5:114. Jesus son of Mary said: O God, our Lord, send down to us a table from heaven: food from heaven; and it is said, a blessing upon the food, for they had with them some food; that it may be a festival for us, for the first of us: for the people of our time; and the last of us: for those who come after us, so that we may worship You on it; and it was a Sunday; and a sign from You: for him who believes, and a proof against him who disbelieves; and provide for us: give us what we have asked of You; and You are the best of providers: the most excellent of those who give food.

5:115. God said: to Jesus: Say to them; I shall send it down to you: what you have asked; but whoever disbelieves afterwards: after its descent and the eating; among you, I shall punish him with a punishment with which I shall punish no one among the worlds: the people of their time: I shall transform him into a swine. They said, after its descent and the eating: This is manifest sorcery, an evident lie. Jesus said: If You punish them for this saying, by which they have deserved destruction, they are Your servants; and if You forgive them, relent towards them and pardon them, then You are the Mighty, in vengeance upon him who does not repent, the Wise, in forgiveness for him who repents. This is an advancing and a postponing in the order of the words.

5:116. And when God said: God will say on the Day of Resurrection; O Jesus son of Mary, did you say to people: in this world; Take me and my mother as two gods besides God? He said: Jesus will say; Glory be to You: he declared his Lord transcendent; it is not: he says, it was not fitting nor permissible; for me to say: to them; what I have no right to: what is not permissible; if I had said it: to them; You would have known it. You know what is in my soul: what command and prohibition came from me to them; and I do not know what is in Your Soul: what forsaking and granting of success came from You to them; indeed You are the Knower of the unseen things: of what is hidden from the servants.

5:117. I said nothing to them: in this world; except what You commanded me: Worship God: declare God One and obey Him; my Lord and your Lord: He is my Lord and your Lord; and I was a witness over them: to the conveying of the message; as long as I was among them: while I was among them; but when You took me: raised him from among them; You were the Watcher over them: the Guardian and Witness over them; and You are over all things: of my speech and their speech; a Witness: Knowing. Jesus said:
5:118. If You punish them, they are Your servants; and if You forgive them, You are the Mighty, the Wise: I have explained it already in what preceded.

5:119. God said: God will say; This is the Day when the truthful will profit from their truthfulness: and the believers from their faith, and those who conveyed the message from their conveying, and those who fulfilled from their fulfilment; for them are gardens: orchards; beneath which flow: beneath their trees and their couches; rivers: rivers of water, milk, wine and honey; abiding therein: dwelling in the Garden, neither dying therein nor departing from it; for ever. God is pleased with them: for their faith and their deeds; and they are pleased with Him: with the reward and the honour; that: which I have mentioned of everlasting abiding and good pleasure; is the great triumph: the abundant deliverance; they have triumphed with the Garden and been delivered from the punishment of the Fire.

5:120. To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: the treasuries of the heavens and the earth; the treasuries of the heavens are rain, and of the earth, plants and fruits and other things; and whatever is in them: of creatures and wonders; and He is over all things: of the creation of the heavens and the earth, and of reward and punishment; Powerful: so praise Him who created the heavens and the earth.

19:16. And mention: O Muḥammad; in the Book: in the Qur'an; Mary: the account of Mary; when she withdrew: she went apart and secluded herself; from her family to an eastern place: on the eastern side of their house.

19:17. And took, apart from them: she let down, apart from her family; a screen: a veil, so as to wash herself therein from menstruation; then We sent to her: after she had finished; Our Spirit: Our messenger Gabriel; and he appeared to her: he took on a likeness for her; as a well-proportioned man: in the form of a young man lacking nothing.

19:18. She said: Mary; I seek refuge: I seek protection; in the Most Gracious from you, if you are God-fearing: obedient to the Most Gracious; and it is said, al-Taqī was the name of a wicked man, and she thought that he was that man, and for that reason she sought refuge from him.
19:19. He said: Gabriel, to her; I am only a messenger of your Lord, to grant you: so that God may grant you; a pure boy: a righteous child.

19:20. She said: Mary, to Gabriel (peace be upon him); How shall I have a boy: from where shall I have a child; when no man has touched me: no husband has come near me; and I have not been unchaste: an adulteress.

19:21. He said: Gabriel, to her; Thus: so it is, as I have told you; your Lord has said: It is easy for Me: his creation is easy for Me, without a father; and that We may make him: so that We may make him; a sign: a mark and a lesson; for people: for the Children of Israel, a child without a father; and a mercy from Us: for him who believes in him; and it is a matter decreed: a decree that is to be, that he should be a child without a father.

19:22. So she conceived him: Mary; and her pregnancy with him lasted nine months, and it is said, a single day; and she withdrew: she went apart; with him: with her giving birth to him; to a distant place: far from people.

19:23. And the pangs of childbirth drove her: the labour-pains compelled her; to the trunk of the palm-tree: to the base of a dried-up palm; she said: Would that I had died before this: this child; and it is said, before this day; and had been a thing forgotten, out of mind: a thing abandoned and not remembered; and it is said, a discarded menstrual cloth; and it is said, a miscarriage.

19:24. Then he called to her from beneath her: from below her, meaning Gabriel; Do not grieve: O Mary, over the birth of Jesus; your Lord has placed beneath you a sariyy: a prophet; and it is said, "then he who was beneath her called to her", if you read it with the fatḥa on the mīm{{fn:The reading man taḥtahā, "he who was beneath her", in place of min taḥtihā, "from beneath her".}}, meaning Jesus: Do not grieve; your Lord has placed beneath you a sariyy, a small stream.
19:25. And shake towards you: take hold, towards you; the trunk of the palm-tree: the base of the palm, and move it; it will drop upon you fresh ripe dates: tender and fresh.

19:26. So eat: of the fresh dates; and drink: from the stream; and be comforted: be of good cheer at the birth of Jesus (peace be upon him); and if you see of mankind: of human beings; anyone: after this day; then say: I have vowed to the Most Gracious a fast: a silence; so I shall not speak today to any human: to any son of Adam; then keep silent after that, until Jesus speaks in your excuse.
19:27. Then she brought him: Jesus; to her people: to her people; carrying him: when he was forty days old; they said: O Mary, you have done a thing unheard of: a tremendous abomination.

19:28. O sister of Aaron: O you who resemble Aaron in worship; and Aaron was a righteous man, among the best of people; and it is said, Aaron was a wicked man and they likened her to him; and it is said, Aaron was her brother on her father's side; your father was not a man of evil: a fornicating man; nor was your mother unchaste: an adulteress.

19:29. So she pointed to him: to Jesus (peace be upon him), meaning: speak to him; they said: to her; How can we speak to one who is in the cradle: in the lap; and it is said, in the bed; a child: a small one, forty days old. Then Jesus (peace be upon him) spoke.
19:30. He said: I am the servant of God; He has given me the Book: He taught me the Torah and the Gospel in my mother's womb; and made me a prophet: after my coming forth from my mother's womb.

19:31. And He has made me blessed: a teacher of good; wherever I am: wherever I am and wherever I dwell; and has enjoined upon me prayer: the completion of prayer; and almsgiving: charity; as long as I live: as long as I am alive.
19:32. And dutiful to my mother: kind to my mother; and He has not made me a tyrant: in my religion, one who kills in anger; wretched: disobedient to my Lord.

19:33. And peace be upon me the day I was born: safety for me when I was born, from the prick of Satan; and the day I die: when I die, from the squeeze of the grave; and the day I am raised alive: when I am raised alive from the grave.

19:34. That is Jesus son of Mary: the account of Jesus son of Mary; the word of truth: the true report; about which: about Jesus; they doubt: they are in doubt, meaning the Christians: some of them said he is God, some of them said he is the son of God, and some of them said he is His partner.

19:35. It is not for God: it does not befit God; to take any son. Glory be to Him: He declared Himself transcendent above child and partner; when He decrees a matter: when He wills to create a child without a father; He only says to it, Be, and it is: a child without a father, like Jesus. And when Jesus came with the message to his people, he said: I am the servant of God and His Messiah.

19:36. And indeed God: He; is my Lord: my Creator and my Provider; and your Lord: your Creator and your Provider; so worship Him: declare Him One; this: the profession of His oneness which I command you; is a straight path: an upright religion with which He is pleased, and it is Islam.

19:37. But the factions differed: the unbelievers; among themselves: between themselves; some of them said he is God, some of them said he is the son of God, and some of them said he is His partner; so woe: Woe (al-wayl) is a valley in Hell of pus and blood; and it is said, a pit in the Fire; and it is said, "so woe" means severe punishment; to those who disbelieve: who formed factions concerning Jesus; from the witnessing of a tremendous Day: from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection.

21:91. And she who: and mention her who; guarded her chastity: guarded the opening of her shift; so We breathed into her of Our Spirit: Gabriel breathed into the opening of her shift, by Our command; and We made her and her son a sign: a mark and a lesson; for the worlds: for the Children of Israel: a child without a father, and a birth without being touched.

23:50. And We made the son of Mary: meaning Jesus; and his mother a sign: a mark and a lesson: a child without a father, and a birth without being touched; and We gave them refuge: We brought them back; to a height: to an elevated place; of settled ground: level, possessed of comfort; and flowing water: visible running water; and it is Damascus.
43:57. And when the son of Mary was cited as an example: they likened him to their gods; behold, your people at it: at the words of ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zibaʿrā and his companions; cry out: they laugh.

43:58. And they said: meaning ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zibaʿrā; Are our gods better: O Muḥammad; or he?: meaning Jesus son of Mary: if it is permissible for him to be in the Fire with the Christians, it is permissible for us to be in the Fire with our gods. They did not cite him to you: they did not mention Jesus son of Mary to you; except for argument: except for disputation and contention; rather, they are a contentious people: disputers with falsehood.

43:59. He is not: he is nothing, meaning Jesus son of Mary; but a servant upon whom We bestowed favour: with the message; and he is not like their gods; and We made him an example: a lesson; for the Children of Israel: a child without a father.

43:60. And if We willed, We could have made from you: in your place; and it is said, We could have created from you; angels in the earth to succeed: successors from you, in your stead; and it is said, walking in the earth in your stead.

43:61. And indeed he: meaning the descent of Jesus son of Mary; is a knowledge of the Hour: a clear indication of the coming of the Hour; and it is said, a mark (ʿalam) of the coming of the Hour, if you read it with the fatḥa on the ʿayn and the lām; so do not doubt it: do not be in doubt about it, about the coming of the Hour; and follow me: in the profession of God's oneness; this: the profession of oneness; is a straight path: an upright religion with which He is pleased, and it is Islam.

43:62. And let him not turn you away: let him not divert you; Satan: from the religion of Islam and the acknowledgement of the coming of the Hour; indeed he is to you a manifest enemy: open in enmity.

43:63. And when Jesus came with clear proofs: with command and prohibition and wonders; he said: I have come to you with wisdom: with command and prohibition and prophethood; and to make clear to you some of that about which you differ: in which you disagree in religion; so fear God: be in awe of God in what He has commanded you; and obey me: follow my counsel and my word.

43:64. Indeed God, He is my Lord: my Creator; and your Lord: your Creator; so worship Him: so declare Him One; this: the profession of oneness; is a straight path: an upright religion with which He is pleased.

43:65. But the factions differed: the Christians; among themselves: between themselves, concerning Jesus: some of them said he is the son of God, and they are the Nestorians; some of them said he is God, and they are the Jacobites (al-Mār Yaʿqūbiyya); some of them said he is His partner, and they are the Melkites; and some of them said he is the third of three, and they are the Marqūsiyya{{fn:A sect named in the Arabic sources after a certain Marqus (Mark); its identity is uncertain.}}; so woe: severe punishment; to those who do wrong: who formed factions concerning Jesus; from the punishment of a painful Day: agonising.

57:27. Then We caused to follow in their footsteps: We sent following and in succession, after Noah and Abraham, among their descendants; Our messengers: one upon the track of another; and We caused to follow in their footsteps: We sent following and in succession, after these messengers, other than Muḥammad (peace and blessings be upon him); Jesus son of Mary, and We gave him: We bestowed upon him; the Gospel, and We placed in the hearts of those who followed him: who followed the religion of Jesus; compassion: tenderness and kindness, each of them inclining in kindness towards the other; and mercy: each of them showing mercy to the other; and monasticism, which they innovated: they prepared for it the hermitages and the monasteries, so as to live as monks therein and to escape the trial of Paul the Jew; We did not prescribe it for them: We did not make monasticism obligatory for them; except seeking the good pleasure of God: except the seeking of God's good pleasure; and it is said: they innovated it only seeking the good pleasure of God; We did not prescribe it for them, that is, We did not make monasticism obligatory for them, and had We made monasticism obligatory for them, they did not observe it: they did not keep monasticism; with its due observance: with its due keeping; so We gave: so We bestowed upon; those of them who believed: of the monks; their reward: their recompense, twice over, for faith and worship; and they are those who did not depart from the religion of Jesus son of Mary; and there remained of them twenty-four men among the people of Yemen, who came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him), believed in him and entered his religion; but many of them: of the monks; are rebellious: unbelievers, and they are those who departed from the religion of Jesus.

61:6. And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel, I am the Messenger of God to you, confirming: in agreement, in the profession of God's oneness and in some of the laws; what was before me of the Torah: what was before me of the Torah; and bringing glad tidings: and I have come to you as a bringer of glad tidings; I give you glad tidings; of a messenger who will come after me, whose name is Aḥmad: he is named Aḥmad, he who is not blamed, and Muḥammad, he who is praised; then when he came to them: Jesus; and it is said, Muḥammad (peace and blessings be upon him); with clear proofs: with command and prohibition and the wonders which he showed them; they said: This is manifest sorcery: evident sorcery and falsehood.
